narrative.coaching_note: Lávese las manos con agua y jabón antes de tocar a resident A a los 21.4 segundos, porque el alcohol no mata las esporas de C. difficile. Usted tocó bed rail A desde los 1.6 segundos y esa contaminación pasó a su bare hand. Después usted tocó call button a los 7.6 segundos y phone a los 12.4 segundos, y luego tocó a resident A a los 21.4 segundos. Faltó la higiene después de tocar el entorno a los 11 segundos y antes de tocar al residente a los 21.4 segundos. Usted trabajó con bare hand todo el tiempo sin hacer higiene de manos durante el video. Lavarse con agua y jabón a los 11 segundos hubiera mantenido limpios bare hand, gloved hand, phone y resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 1.6 seconds with transfer to bare hand, then to call button at 7.6 seconds, to phone at 12.4 seconds, and to resident A at 21.4 seconds, producing one resident exposure at 21.4 seconds. Hand hygiene compliance was 0 of 2 opportunities overall, including Moment 1: 0 of 1 and Moment 5: 0 of 1. No hygiene events and no glove events occurred. No glove use issues were recorded. For C. difficile, alcohol rub does not clear hands; soap and water is required. Surfaces to disinfect are bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A's bedside zone (linen and surfaces). Use an EPA List K sporicidal disinfectant (effective against C. difficile spores); standard disinfectants do not kill spores.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene with soap and water for Moment 1 before touching resident A at 21.4 seconds.
